_notes: Fish Finder Zone 2 — Mid-Atlantic (NJ/DE/MD/VA/NC). Home port: Cape May, NJ. Seeded 2026-08-22 from Second Mate pre-scoped playbook. Beta — captain-intel sources not yet wired; picks rank on seasonal presence + SST fit + canyon proximity until captain heat scores populate.

home_port.name: Utsch's Marina
home_port.notes: Cape May primary — access to Hudson (60nm), Baltimore, Wilmington canyons + Cape May Rips + Delaware Bay mouth.

boat.notes: Same profile as Zone 1 default — visitor can customize via ⚓ chip.

zones.name: Hudson Canyon
zones.notes: 60 nm SE of Cape May. Premier NJ canyon — yellowfin + mahi trolling, chunking bluefin, white marlin. Classic canyon action Jul-Oct.

zones.name: Baltimore Canyon
zones.notes: ~85 nm from Cape May. Fleet-favorite canyon out of Ocean City MD. World Cup Blue Marlin territory Aug.

zones.name: Wilmington Canyon
zones.notes: ~75 nm from Cape May. Middle NJ/DE canyon — often less pressured than Hudson or Baltimore.

zones.name: Poor Man's Canyon
zones.notes: ~110 nm from Cape May — edge range. Consistent white marlin producer late Aug through Sep.

zones.name: Washington Canyon
zones.notes: ~130 nm from Cape May — canyon-fleet only. Gulf Stream proximity variable — track daily western-edge.

zones.name: 20-Fathom Line (E of OC)
zones.notes: ~50 nm from Cape May. Chunk-and-jig bluefin nearshore of the canyon proper. Kings on trolled ballyhoo.

zones.name: 26-Mile Hill
zones.notes: ~55 nm from Cape May. Consistent bluefin midshore pick summer. Named for distance E of OC.

zones.name: Jackspot (Hot Dog)
zones.notes: 20 nm E of Ocean City. Classic Delmarva bluefin + mako hot spot. Sight-fish tuna busts on bait.

zones.name: The Cigar (E of VA Beach)
zones.notes: ~130 nm from Cape May — VA canyon-fleet spot. Consistent yellowfin producer, king mackerel abundant summer.

zones.name: The Fingers
zones.notes: VA/MD border midshore, ~110 nm from Cape May. Bottom finger contours hold bait — trolled and chunked for tuna.

zones.name: Barnegat Ridge
zones.notes: 30-fathom line ~30 nm E of Barnegat Inlet, ~65 nm from Cape May. Chunk-and-jig bluefin classic. School bluefin all summer.

zones.name: Manasquan Ridge
zones.notes: N NJ nearshore — ~85 nm from Cape May, better from Manasquan itself. Bluefin + mahi run mid-summer.

zones.name: Sea Girt Reef
zones.notes: N NJ artificial reef ~2 nm off Sea Girt. Bluefin school in summer, stripers spring + fall migration.

zones.name: Cape May Rips
zones.notes: The reefs and rips just off Cape May Point — 15 nm from home port. Striper fall migration is stellar. Albies Sep-Oct.

zones.name: Fenwick Shoal
zones.notes: ~35 nm from Cape May. Kings + Spanish push into the shoal on warm-water tongues.

zones.name: Delaware Bay Mouth
zones.notes: 10 nm from home port. Best striper action spring + fall migration; chunk bunker or troll.

zones.name: CBBT (Chesapeake Bay Mouth)
zones.notes: Chesapeake Bay Bridge Tunnel — VA's signature spot. Sight-fish cobia summer, bull-red drum schools fall, winter striper migration.

zones.name: Oregon Inlet (NC)
zones.notes: OBX gateway inlet. Wintertime giant striper run (Nov-Mar). Kings + Spanish + cobia summer. Fleet posts daily.

zones.name: Diamond Shoals (Hatteras)
zones.notes: Cape Hatteras shoals. Winter giant bluefin fishery (Jan-Mar) — world-class. Summer kings + mahi. Extreme currents.

zones.name: The Point (Hatteras)
zones.notes: Where the Gulf Stream comes closest to shore — 12-25 nm. Year-round tuna. Sailfish in warm months. Small-boat access from Hatteras Village.

zones.name: Toms Canyon
zones.notes: 70+ nm E of Barnegat Inlet. Yellowfin June-Oct, bigeye chunk bite mid-summer.

zones.name: Lindenkohl Canyon
zones.notes: Deep-water canyon 85 nm E of Little Egg Inlet. Bigeye + white marlin summer.

zones.name: Spencer Canyon
zones.notes: White marlin corridor Aug-Sep. Deep-drop swordfish.

zones.name: Norfolk Canyon
zones.notes: Southern-most Mid-Atl canyon — 60nm E of Rudee Inlet. Tuna + bill summer.

zones.name: The Mud Hole (NJ)
zones.notes: Bluefin migration corridor 30nm E of Manasquan. Summer tuna push.

zones.name: Bacardi Wreck
zones.notes: Deep-water wreck 40nm E of Barnegat. Big sea bass + cod.

zones.name: Immigrant Wreck
zones.notes: 185ft freighter 45nm E of Atlantic City. Structure bite year-round.

zones.name: Mohawk Wreck
zones.notes: USS Mohawk cutter, deep wreck 35nm E of Barnegat.

zones.name: Delaware II / Fire Island Buoy area
zones.notes: Series of wrecks off Long Island south shore — Mid-Atl-adjacent.

zones.name: Triple Wrecks Reef
zones.notes: State artificial reef complex 8nm E of Atlantic City.

zones.name: Indian River Ledge
zones.notes: Deep-water ledge 30nm E of Indian River Inlet.

zones.name: Delaware Bay Mouth Wrecks
zones.notes: Cluster of wrecks around Del Bay mouth. Winter tog + spring stripers.

zones.name: 49th St Reef (Ocean City DE)
zones.notes: State artificial reef offshore Ocean City Delaware.

zones.name: 20 Fathom Line (E of Indian River)
zones.notes: Contour break 40nm E of Indian River Inlet. Bottom fishing productive.

zones.name: Great Gully (MD Offshore)
zones.notes: Deep gully 45nm E of Ocean City MD. Yellowfin + bottom combo.

zones.name: The Chicken Bone
zones.notes: Structure formation 50nm E of Ocean City. Chicken-bone shaped drop.

zones.name: The Hot Dog (Extended)
zones.notes: Southern extension of the Jackspot ridge.

zones.name: Wilmington Lump
zones.notes: Underwater mound 55nm E of Ocean City. Summer yellowfin bite.

zones.name: The Ridge (MD)
zones.notes: Long submerged ridge system 35nm E of Ocean City.

zones.name: CBBT (Chesapeake Bay Bridge Tunnel)
zones.notes: All 4 pilings + islands. Trophy striper + cobia migration. Winter deep tog.

zones.name: Chesapeake Light Tower
zones.notes: USCG light tower 13nm E of Cape Henry. Cobia migration May-Aug.

zones.name: Triangle Wrecks (VA)
zones.notes: 3 USS destroyers scuttled in a triangle formation. Wreck bite year-round.

zones.name: MDT Tower Wreck
zones.notes: MDT (Marine Deployment Target) tower wreck 20nm E of Cape Henry.

zones.name: The 4 Pack (VA)
zones.notes: Cluster of tower buoys 5nm off Cape Henry. Cobia sight fishing.

zones.name: Norfolk Canyon Edge (Deep Drop)
zones.notes: Deep-drop swordfish along the canyon rim. Daytime sword.

zones.name: Oregon Inlet Break
zones.notes: 20nm E of Oregon Inlet — Gulf Stream edge. Tuna daily in season.

zones.name: The Point (Avon NC)
zones.notes: Where the Gulf Stream pinches closest to shore in NC. Legendary bill spot.

sst_layer.notes: Same SST source as Northeast. 68–72°F break zones are the tuna target; 70–82°F for cobia + kings.

recreational.notes: HMS Angling recreational size class. Same rules as Northeast.

giant.notes: Trophy — Hatteras winter fishery is world-class. Release-only for Angling category.

heat_scale_rubric.1-2: No current activity for this species
heat_scale_rubric.5-6: Steady reports, moderate density, a real option
heat_scale_rubric.7-8: Hot — multiple boats scoring, consistent action
heat_scale_rubric.9-10: On fire — the bite zone this week

species_calendars._note: Mid-Atlantic baseline — Cape May, NJ → Cape Hatteras, NC. Timing shifts south vs Northeast: bluefin runs later (peak NJ Nov, NC Jan-Mar), yellowfin holds longer, king mackerel + cobia + red drum active summer-fall.
